name: Boseiju District
description: The great tree over Towashi that once held the plane together and is shattered by Tamiyo's reading.

pages_say.description: The kami-filled forest district, home to the Order of Jukai, with a merge gate.
The district at the roots of the mighty Boseiju tree where the hideout stands.
A great tree in Kamigawa that exists in harmony with spirits.
The great tree over Towashi that once held the plane together and is shattered by Tamiyo's reading.
